is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and other Anopheles species in northern Côte d'Ivoire.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions that the local An. gambiae complex has high frequencies of kdr mutations and moderate frequencies of the ace-1 allele (page 3), but it cites a previous study (Zogo et al. 2019) for these data. The current study does not report new genotype data for these or any other resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not provide any genotype counts or frequencies for resistance markers for the mosquitoes collected in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in four rural villages in the department of Napiélédougou, Côte d'Ivoire.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study evaluating the impact of Bti larviciding combined with LLINs.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies four villages: Kakologo, Kolékaha, Lofinékaha, and Nambatiourkaha in the Napiélédougou department.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from March 2019 to February 2020.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new field trial.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any resistance marker genotype data, so no supplementary data is needed for this purpose.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the impact of Bti larviciding combined with LLINs on malaria transmission in northern Côte d'Ivoire. While it mentions insecticide resistance (kdr and ace-1) in the background, it cites previous work for these data and does not perform or report any new genotyping of resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report new genotype data for resistance markers; it only cites previous studies for existing resistance data.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype data (counts or frequencies) for resistance markers are provided for the study population.
